name: Motorcycle Obby for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Motorcycle Obby For Brainrots! 🏍️

⚡Ride fast and balance your Motorcycle!
🤾‍♂️Jump across crazy Obby stages!
💀 Don’t fall into the void!
💸 Upgrade your Brainrots and earn more money!
🏗️ Upgrade your base for more slots!

💤 Your Brainrots earns Cash offline! 

If you’re having fun, don't forget to like the game! 👍
